subject: Intro: TechSys referral - Finlytics demo scheduling
messages:
From: Nathan Liu <nathan.liu@techsys.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@finlytics.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-20T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Intro: Finlytics <> Redwood (partner referral)

Hi Marissa and Priya -

Hope you both are well. Quick intro: I’m Nathan, Channel Director at TechSys - we’ve been working with Redwood on a few inference deployments and thought Finlytics might benefit from a short intro/demo. Priya - Finlytics mentioned you’re evaluating inference options for document summarization and secure embeddings; I suggested Redwood based on the latency/cost profile and the team’s ability to support private deployments.

Marissa, can you share availability for a 30-45 minute demo next week? Priya, feel free to include anyone from your team who should join. I’ve cc’d Alex from Redwood who manages partner motion.

Thanks - happy to join the call if helpful.

--Nathan
Nathan Liu
Channel Director, TechSys
Nathan.Liu@techsys.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finlytics.com>
Cc: Nathan Liu <nathan.liu@techsys.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-20T14:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Finlytics <> Redwood (partner referral)
Attachments: Redwood-Intro-Deck.pdf (application/pdf)

Hi Priya -

Thanks Nathan - really appreciate the intro. Priya, great to meet you. Quick note on what we usually cover in a first call: 20-25 minute product walkthrough focused on inference latency/cost, security model (private/VPC options), and a brief Q&A to map to your use case (document summarization + embeddings).

Can you do either of these slots?
- Wed 9/22, 10:00 AM PT (30 mins)
- Thu 9/23, 11:00 AM PT (30 mins)
If neither works, drop 2-3 times that do and I’ll send a calendar invite.

I’ve attached a short intro deck to give your team context before the meeting. If there are any specific folks you want on the call (security, infra), let me know and I’ll loop them in.

Thanks - looking forward to connecting.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior SDR, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
https://calendly.com/marissa-redwood/30min

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finlytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Nathan Liu <nathan.liu@techsys.com>
Date: 2026-09-20T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Finlytics <> Redwood (partner referral)

Hi Marissa -

Thanks for the deck and quick reply. Wed 9/22 at 10:00 AM PT conflicts with an all-hands on our side - would Thu 9/23 at 11:00 AM PT work instead? That time looks good for myself and our Head of Data (she’ll be on the call).

High-level goals for the call:
- Understand latency/cost tradeoffs for short vs long-context summarization
- Security: support for private VPC and key management
- Integration pattern for embeddings and retriever pipeline

Happy to include a short pre-read if useful.

Thanks,
Priya Shah
Product Manager - ML, Finlytics
priya.shah@finlytics.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Attachments: Mutual-Action-Plan.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Hi Priya -

Thu 9/23 at 11:00 AM PT works for us - I’ve scheduled the session and reserved 30 minutes. Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=finlytics-demo-20260923-1100

I’ve attached a short mutual action plan with a few suggested pre-demo items (example data slices, security contacts) to help us make the most of the time. If you want more time (45 mins) we can extend - let me know.

Attendees (invited): Priya Shah (Finlytics), Head of Data (Finlytics), Marissa Cole (Redwood), Alex Martinez (Redwood), Nathan Liu (TechSys)

See you then - I’ll follow up with the calendar invite and dial-in.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior SDR, Redwood Inference

Hi Priya -

Thanks for coordinating - I’ll join the call on Thu 9/23 at 11:00 AM PT. Camila (cc’d) is our solutions engineer and will bring a short set of notes/examples for a document-summarization eval. Camila, can you prepare:
- 1 slide on deployment options (hosted vs dedicated vs private)
- 2 quick benchmark numbers for ~1-3k token summarization (latency/cost)

Priya - if you have a sample doc or a short prompt we should test during the demo, please reply here or upload to the shared folder. I’ll also drop our HubSpot link for the record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DL-2026-0951

Looking forward to it.

Best,
